selection.scope: SAR-only coastal geometry development diagnostic; no scheduler, delivery result, or formal simulation config
selection.selection_rule: All five coastal points and all three architecture groups fixed before propagation; retain every selected acquisition, including empty clock hours; no ground-contact or scheduling-result filtering
selection.minimum_requirement: At least one acquisition release in every UTC hour; short gaps permitted
selection.requirement_scope: A necessary screening criterion for 24h task supply; not guaranteed continuous observation or operational imaging feasibility
selection.target_scope: Five documented NOAA tide-station coordinates representing civilian US coastal harbor reference points; radius=0, not full harbor coverage

sar.phase_rule: Uniform in each plane; 1/2/4 slots are nested subsets of 0/90/180/270 degrees
sar.architecture_reason: Twelve RAAN planes spread local crossing times; along-track density alone cannot fill all local-time gaps
sar.release_rule: capture end strictly before 86400s; focused-product ready delay remains uncalibrated
sar.geometry_scope: Optimistic both-side angular screen; no squint, slew, dwell tracking, beam, swath, cloud, energy, or imaging duty-cycle validation
sar.product_size_scope: Vendor product bound only; not raw echo volume or actual per-event transport load

helpers.note: Role metadata retained; connectivity and delivery are not audited here

selection.sampling: SAR eligibility checked at start, +5s, +10s, and end +15s; between-sample feasibility is not proved; short windows may be missed
selection.night_definition: Approximate geometric solar elevation <0 degrees at target at capture start; 0..21 degrees is not night but is excluded for optical
selection.task_ready_caveat: Capture-end timestamps are geometric acquisition releases, not calibrated ready-for-inference task arrivals
selection.evidence_boundary: No guarantee that adding sources increases compute utilization; no SAR computation model is set

application.task: Civilian vessel detection in a formed and ready SAR image
application.target_presence: Target coordinates designate hypothetical observation requests; no claim that vessels were present or images acquired on this date
application.sla_origin: P300 starts when the formed SAR image is ready for tiled inference; ends when the full image result is aggregated on the ground
application.image_formation: Radar echo focusing and its uncalibrated ready delay are outside the P300 processing interval
application.workload_calibration: No inference model, tile count, compute demand, or actual image product is assigned by this geometry audit

node_identity.note: Legacy sparse IDs preserve identical SAR orbits across geometry audits; a formal 34/46/70-node simulation must explicitly remap IDs

selection.removal_independence: Capture spacing is per source and each window belongs to one source; removing optical sources cannot change selection for retained SAR sources. Coastal target changes are newly propagated and are not filtered from prior inland events.

densest_300s.interval_rule: [start_s, start_s+300); ties at same instant all count
